note: Labeled set for the assess clickbait triage. Each case carries the metadata the app sends (see models.VideoMeta); the channel's usual format is described in channel_description / channel_titles, not a separate genre field. `expected` is `not_clickbait` (the card keeps the title) or `clickbait` (the title/thumbnail makes a clear, out-of-the-ordinary mismatch and the card is marked or hidden). It measures the triage before the context-aware prompt (a punchy headline on a subscribed creator's regular show was flagged) and after. The Jimmy Carr cases are faithful stand-ins for the owner's report (u-tubot#178); record the real video into fixtures/youtube and drop its id in to make the set exact. Owner-only: never fetched from YouTube by tests or CI.
